label: letter r has appeared earlier in the sequence (r-memory, strongest for early r)
explanation: Fires once an r has been input at some earlier step, in both the original and copy phases; it is never active at t<2. Activation builds over the steps after the r is input, peaks around <DEL> and while r is being recalled (out_tok==r: 92% active; next_out==r: 68%), then decays after r has been copied back out. The largest activations come from sequences that start with r or repeat r (first_tok r has 6.4x lift). Sequences where r appears late give only weak activation, and that weak activation accounts for most of the false positives (precision 0.38). There is also a weaker, diffuse response to k (out_tok k 41%, first_tok k 3.5x) and low-level activity in sequences that contain no r, which make up about 14% of the mass. Adding conditions for early r position or for r not yet output raises precision to about 0.63 but lowers recall, so dev F1 stays near 0.5.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=r (+6.80), out_tok=r (+6.15), orig0=r (+5.12), next_out=r (+4.52), orig1=r (+4.26), out_tok=k (+3.44). Lower it: phase=2 & in_tok=q (-11.28), out_tok=q (-7.85), phase=2 & in_tok=v (-6.63), out_tok=v (-5.76).
